# What this repository is built against, one line per source: name, git URL, release.
# omx-contract: the release whose resolved data every plugin declaration references (tools/omx-contract.mjs);
#   moving it is one commit of its own, with omx-dsp's when the pair moves (tools/pins-check.sh).
# omx-dsp: the release whose kernels the faces call (pkg-config omxdsp); omx-dsp requires the same omx-contract.
omx-contract https://github.com/FreeMixer/omx-contract 2.0.0
omx-dsp https://github.com/FreeMixer/omx-dsp 0.4.0
